decision.method: Relevant reuse candidate; complete source-code-only classification and terms review before adoption. Do not build a custom substitute during that review.

decision.next_finite_step: Audit author classification rules without notebook outputs or labels; verify license scope, tested/generated negatives, exact sequence identity and absent-expansion handling. Then adopt verified scope or close candidate.

Match candidates/learner/seeds/budget, keep scored labels/derivatives out of inputs, preserve all prior results. Unknown Pharos lineage limits interpretation but does not forbid a clearly labeled internal paired effect.
decision.confirmatory_independent_claim: Requires fresh suitably separated evidence and declared overlap/leakage limits; source-fidelity inputs cannot serve as concealed biological validation.
